essential_functions.meaning: Sense or estimate when the plants need water
Deliver water to the plants
Start and stop watering automatically based on that need
Hold or connect to a supply of water

expected_unknowns.meaning: Number, size and location of the plants (indoor or outdoor, pots or bed)
Where the water comes from (tap, tank or container)
Whether mains power is available near the plants

meaningful_choice.meaning: Deciding watering need from measured soil moisture versus watering on a fixed schedule; and gravity-fed versus pumped water delivery

cases.notes: Canonical positive case: the person explicitly does not know the components; a provisional concept with generic component types and open unknowns is expected.

essential_functions.meaning: Hold wet clothes so air can reach them
Shield the laundry from dust and rain
Speed up drying without electricity

expected_unknowns.meaning: Size of the balcony and how much laundry it must hold
Sun and wind exposure of the balcony

exclusions.meaning: Any electrically powered part (heater, fan, motor)

cases.notes: MSA. Any concept using a heater, electric fan or motor contradicts the exclusion; passive airflow or solar heating is fine.

expected_unknowns.meaning: What specifically is annoying in the morning (cold seats, frost, finding keys, traffic...)

cases.notes: No identifiable function; the model should ask what problem is meant before proposing components.

essential_functions.meaning: Determine the cat's location
Send the location to the owner's phone or display
Attach securely and comfortably to a collar
Supply power to the tracker

expected_unknowns.meaning: How far the cat roams (house and garden versus neighbourhood)
Acceptable size and weight for the cat
How often the owner is willing to recharge or replace the battery

any_of: a battery that never runs out

unsupported_claims.meaning: A guarantee that the tracker or cat can never be lost

cases.notes: A concept is fine but must not promise endless power or zero loss; battery life is a trade-off to disclose.

essential_functions.meaning: Store enough food for the days the owner is away
Release a measured portion at set times
Keep track of the feeding schedule
Keep working while the owner is away

expected_unknowns.meaning: How many days and meals per day it must cover
Dry or wet food
Whether power at home is reliable or a battery is needed

meaningful_choice.meaning: Portion release by a rotating compartment wheel versus an auger/screw dispenser; or a timed mechanical design versus an electronic timer

cases.notes: Gulf dialect positive case; person does not know components.

essential_functions.meaning: Give him something stable to push or pull on while standing
Reduce the effort of rising from a seated position
Stay fixed and not slide or tip during use

expected_unknowns.meaning: Type and height of the armchair
How much assistance he needs and his weight
Whether it may be attached to the chair or the floor

any_of: must not plug into the wall

cases.notes: A powered lift chair contradicts both exclusions; passive levers, springs or handles are acceptable. No safety guarantee may be claimed.
An opinion/complaint about a public service; no invention to design.

expected_unknowns.meaning: Which kitchen task or problem the device should help with

cases.notes: Egyptian dialect. Only 'for the kitchen' is known; a question must come first.

essential_functions.meaning: Observe how much the dough has risen in the bowl
Decide when the rise has reached the desired amount
Alert the baker when it is ready

expected_unknowns.meaning: What counts as 'risen enough' for the baker (e.g. doubled in size)
Bowl shape and size
Whether the alert should be a sound near the bowl or a message to a phone

meaningful_choice.meaning: Measuring dough height from above versus judging by elapsed time and temperature; or a simple mechanical float indicator versus an electronic sensor

essential_functions.meaning: Protect the rider's head as a helmet
Make the rider visible at night with light
Signal to drivers behind the rider

expected_unknowns.meaning: Whether the lights should be steady, flashing or show braking/turning
How the lights are powered and recharged
Whether the lights are added to an existing helmet or a new helmet is to be made

unsupported_claims.meaning: A guarantee of 100% head protection in any accident

cases.notes: Gulf dialect. Concept may add lighting to a helmet but must not promise complete protection or claim certification.

essential_functions.meaning: Discourage pigeons from landing on the railing
Fit along the existing railing

expected_unknowns.meaning: Railing length, shape and material
Whether the person accepts noise, movement or visual deterrents

cases.notes: Spikes, gels or harmful methods contradict the exclusions; e.g. sloped or rotating surfaces are acceptable.

essential_functions.meaning: Detect the car's position as it moves into the garage
Indicate to the driver when to stop
Be mounted where the driver can notice it

expected_unknowns.meaning: Garage dimensions and where the shelves are
Whether power is available at the mounting spot

meaningful_choice.meaning: A purely mechanical cue (hanging marker or wheel stop) versus a distance sensor with a light signal

cases.notes: Egyptian dialect. A purchase opinion about someone else's product; no invention.

expected_unknowns.meaning: What the 'thing' is
What the 'weird stuff' is

cases.notes: Object and problem both unidentified; must ask first.

essential_functions.meaning: Keep the medication schedule
Remind her at each dose time
Check whether the dose was actually taken

expected_unknowns.meaning: How many medicines and doses per day
Whether she can hear, see and handle small buttons or a phone
Whether a family member should be notified remotely

meaningful_choice.meaning: A pill box with compartments that senses opening versus a reminder she confirms by pressing a button

cases.notes: MSA positive case. 'Actually taken' can only be inferred (e.g. compartment opened); the model should disclose that limit.

essential_functions.meaning: Measure the water temperature
Warm or cool the water toward the target
Detect when temperature leaves the acceptable range
Notify the owner remotely

expected_unknowns.meaning: Tank volume and the fish species' temperature range
Room temperature range (whether cooling is needed at all)
How the owner wants to be notified

meaningful_choice.meaning: Heating only versus heating plus cooling; sending the alert through the home internet connection versus through a mobile-network message that still works if the home internet is down

adjudication.statement: The adjudicator reviewed these cases and references without seeing any candidate prompt, schema, scoring code or model response for this evaluation.

changes.C05: C05-F1 changed from 'Store several days of dry food' to 'Store enough food for the days the owner is away': the idea does not say the food is dry and C05-U2 lists dry versus wet food as unknown, so the function must not presuppose it.
changes.C10: Added C10-U3 (whether lights are added to an existing helmet or a new helmet is to be made): the idea says 'make a helmet', and this decision determines whether head protection comes from an existing helmet or must be designed and tested anew.
changes.C15: Removed C15-F4 'Let someone know if a dose is missed': the grandmother's idea asks only to remind and to make sure the dose was taken; notifying someone else is a possible proposal, not an essential function, and is already covered as the open question C15-U3.
changes.C16: Replaced the 'local alarm versus phone notification' half of meaningful_choice: the owner is away at work, so a local alarm alone does not meet the stated need and is not a genuine alternative; the replacement (home internet versus mobile-network alert) is a functionally different choice.
